scenarios.title: First trick
scenarios.prompt: This is the first trick. Barbu led 2C, and you still have a club. Choose the legal play.

scenarios.title: First trick
scenarios.prompt: The opening trick is clean so far. Follow clubs without taking control if you can.

scenarios.title: First trick
scenarios.prompt: Clubs were led on the first trick, but you have no clubs. Choose the safe discard before dumping points.

scenarios.title: Avoid hearts
scenarios.prompt: Clubs were led. Right is winning with KC, and Left may add a heart. Follow clubs without taking the point.

scenarios.title: Avoid hearts
scenarios.prompt: Diamonds were led. You are void, and Right is already winning. Choose a discard.

scenarios.title: Avoid hearts
scenarios.prompt: Hearts were led. Right is winning with QH, and you must follow hearts. Stay under the winner if you can.

scenarios.title: Queen of Spades danger
scenarios.prompt: Spades were led. Right has put the queen of spades into the trick. Follow spades without winning it.

scenarios.title: Queen of Spades danger
scenarios.prompt: Clubs were led. You are void, and Barbu is already winning. This is a chance to move the queen of spades.

scenarios.title: Queen of Spades danger
scenarios.prompt: Spades were led. You hold the queen of spades, but no higher spade is protecting you.

scenarios.title: Only hearts remain
scenarios.prompt: No heart has been played. You won the previous trick and have only hearts left. Choose your lead.

scenarios.title: Follow the heart lead
scenarios.prompt: Now consider the follower's decision. Barbu has led 2H from an all-heart hand. Choose your card.

scenarios.title: Choose the next lead
scenarios.prompt: In this later position, hearts are broken and you won the last trick. Choose a legal lead.

scenarios.title: Stop the moon
scenarios.prompt: Barbu has every point so far and is winning a loaded club trick. Decide whether to take the point away.

scenarios.title: Stop the moon
scenarios.prompt: Left is threatening to collect every point. The queen of spades is in this trick, and you can take it away.

scenarios.title: Stop the moon
scenarios.prompt: Barbu has all the points so far and is about to win another heart trick. Decide whether to take one point now.

scenarios.title: Score a hand
scenarios.prompt: This trick has several cards. Choose the 13-point danger card.

scenarios.title: Score a hand
scenarios.prompt: There is no queen of spades in this trick. Choose the one-point penalty card.

scenarios.title: Score a hand
scenarios.prompt: Choose the clean card: the card that adds no Hearts penalty points.

passes.explanation: Passing all three high spades removes the queen and the ace/king that could catch it later. High hearts remain a risk; incoming cards may change the plan.
passes.missedPlanExplanation: The queen, king and ace have no low spade cover. For this exercise, pass them together rather than leaving high spades behind.
passes.prompt: Your only spades are the queen, king and ace. Choose a pass that removes this exposed spade holding.
passes.title: Remove exposed spades

passes.explanation: The queen has only one low spade for cover. Passing it with both high hearts removes danger while keeping your low clubs together.
passes.missedPlanExplanation: Keep the low club run as exits. Move the exposed queen with the high hearts, or with both diamonds to create a void.

alternatives.explanation: A sound alternative: move the queen and empty diamonds without breaking the clubs. You keep high hearts, and incoming diamonds may refill the void.

passes.prompt: Keep the long club run as low exits. Remove danger or create a diamond void with your three-card pass.
passes.title: Keep low exits
Create a void
passes.prompt: Diamonds are a short suit headed by ace and king. Pass three cards to empty that suit while keeping your low spades.
passes.explanation: All three diamonds leave together. If no diamonds arrive, later diamond leads let you discard danger. Keep low spades to duck under the queen.
passes.missedPlanExplanation: Passing only the high diamonds leaves 3D, so you must still follow diamonds. For this exercise, empty the suit and keep your low spades.
